say:1:1710336001:0.text: Have the sales figures for the new products come in?
say:1:1710336001:0.source_cn: 这批新款的销售数据回来了吗？

say:2:1710336002:0.text: The new products haven't made much of an impact on revenue...
say:2:1710336002:0.source_cn: 新款给销售额带来的提升并不是很明显……

say:3:1710336003:0.text: How could this happen?! This is my first time as lead product designer, and Master Rowan himself approved my designs...
say:3:1710336003:0.source_cn: 怎么会这样！我好不容易第一次担任产品设计的负责人，内部...

say:4:1710336004:0.text: I don't think this is your fault! The launch of our new products just happened to coincide with the disappearance of the Hall of Ancients...
say:4:1710336004:0.source_cn: 我想这不是你的原因！谁让我们的新款发布刚好赶上圣古堂消...

say:5:1710336005:0.text: I'm sure the sales of the other lines have taken a hit too...
say:5:1710336005:0.source_cn: 不光是你负责的新款，其他系列的销售额肯定也会受影响……
